headline: Coca-Cola FEMSA Volumes Rise in Mexico Despite Margin Pressures
summary: Coca-Cola FEMSA reported that strong sales of the 3-litre bottle boosted its Mexican volumes during the third quarter, though the packaging format put pressure on profit margins.
why: Packaging mix shifts can drive volume growth for beverage bottlers while simultaneously impacting cost structures and operating margins.

impacts.name: Coca-Cola FEMSA
impacts.why: Sales volumes increased while profit margins faced pressure.
